_about: SL_MagicMenu strings, English - the magic menu's own texts (preview box, spell card, layout buttons) and the fallback for any key another language file lacks; a key missing here too shows the plugin's built-in English. Keep the {placeholders} and the ' · ' separators as they are.
settings_lang_note: Applies the next time the magic menu opens.
settings_lang_titles: Add-on block titles and this tab's name change after the game restarts.
settings_blocks_note: Unticked blocks are left out of the magic menu; their places in the layout are kept. Applies the next time the magic menu opens.
settings_blocks_builtin: Without the spell card, SkyUI's own item card shows in its usual place; without the 3D preview, the game draws the spell's 3D itself.
